chunks: And Moses said: 'My Lord knows best who has come with guidance from Him, and for whom will be the consequence of the home. Indeed, the wicked will not succeed.'
ai.seo_question: What did Moses say about who brings guidance from God?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Moses (AS) articulates the criterion for recognizing true prophets by contrasting divine knowledge of guidance with the ultimate fate of the righteous versus the unjust. Shia scholarship emphasizes this as a foundational principle of *usul al-din*, linking the concept of *Adl* (Divine Justice) with the certainty of the Hereafter, where the *'aqibah* (end result) serves as the definitive proof of truth. The statement underscores that worldly power of the oppressors is transient, while true success is reserved for those who align with God's will.
